scope: Fix video thumbnail rendering, eliminate green box placeholders, and ensure proper poster updates

tasks.title: Fix Video Thumbnail Display & Eliminate Green Box on addVideo
tasks.description: Resolve the issue in addVideo where newly embedded videos show an unrendered placeholder or solid green box instead of an actual thumbnail. Ensure that when a poster image is supplied (path, Buffer, or base64 data URI), it is correctly ingested into ppt/media/, registered in [Content_Types].xml, bound to an image relationship in ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels, and referenced via <p:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId..."/> inside <p:pic>. If no poster is explicitly provided, generate or embed a valid default poster image rather than a malformed or empty blip reference.

tasks.title: Fix Video Poster / Thumbnail Replacement in updateVideo
tasks.description: Fix the issue in updateVideo where changing the poster or video source leaves the old thumbnail displayed. When updateVideo is called with a new poster or replacement video source: (1) Ingest the new thumbnail into ppt/media/, (2) Update or replace the image relationship target in the slide's .rels file, (3) Update <p:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rIdNew"/> to point directly to the new relationship ID, and (4) Purge or clean up orphaned thumbnail binaries to prevent caching stale posters.

tasks.title: Update Showcase Script, Add Regression Tests & Verify
tasks.description: Update showcase/media_advanced.js to demonstrate adding a video with a visible poster image and subsequently updating that video's thumbnail to a distinct new image. Add automated integration tests in tests/integration/videoThumbnail.test.js checking relationship targets, blip references, and [Content_Types].xml entries. Verify that opening the resulting presentation in Microsoft PowerPoint displays the correct thumbnails without green boxes or repair errors.
